title: West Side President’s Son Graduates Cum Laude
html:
West Side Branch President Dr. Esther Lopez is proud to share that her son, Nathaniel Joaquin Lopez, graduated Cum Laude from Oak Park and River Forest High School this spring.

This fall, he will attend Loyola University at Chicago, where he was awarded the prestigious Presidential Merit Scholarship. Nathaniel will pursue a Bachelor of Science in Public Health on the Pre-Dental Track, with plans to continue his education toward a career in dentistry.
